description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and new side facing window
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 02, 03, 04, fire safety statement. Received: 26/07/2023
05(Rev.B), 06(Rev.B), 07(Rev.B). Received: 22/09/2023
01(Rev.B). Received: 25/09/2023
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevation of the development hereby permitted.

Condition : 5 - The window formed in the south-western side elevation shall be fitted with obscure-glazing. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition.
